description: NaSrHfSbO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Hf is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Hf-O bond lengths are 2.06 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-O bond lengths are 1.99 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one Hf, and one Sb atom.
